abilities.name: Trump-Card Kitty

summons.label: Cuilein-Anbar
_curatorNotes: A4 passive (The Languid Wood) extends zone duration by +1s per dendro reaction triggered within the zone, up to 3 times (max +3s → up to 9s total). gcsim: c.AddStatus(burstKey, 378, false) fires at explosionHitmark (25 frames); A4 calls c.ExtendStatus(burstKey, 60) capped at burstExtendCount < 3. Authored 2026-05-10 (E3 v1.5) as durationExtensions[] on this summon. Parser cast-only emission fires dendro reactions only on Collei's own E/Q casts — teammates' reactions in the zone are not modeled, so extensions under-fire in real rotations. Practical: a `Collei E Q` after some aura applicator fires up to 2 extensions (+2s); the third in-game extension (from teammate reactions) is not captured. Acceptable approximation; future P4 expansion (per-hit + team event emission) would close the gap.

Leap tick series, authored 2026-08-17 (gauge round L5e data residue). gcsim internal/characters/collei/burst.go: burstTicks() queues AttackInfo 'Trump-Card Kitty (Leap)', Element attributes.Dendro, Durability 25 (1U), Mult burstLeap[c.TalentLvlBurst()], then re-queues itself on leapTickPeriod = 30 frames (0.5s). First tick at const leapHitmark = 68 frames from cast start; the summon's authored spawnsAt is 25 (const explosionHitmark), so firstTickDelay = (68 − 25)/60 = 0.717s. Scaling from zz_collei.dm.go burstLeap index 9 (talent level 10) = 0.778464 → 77.8464%; sidecar docs/curation/talents/collei.json row 'Leap DMG' 10th value = 77.8%, authored at the sidecar's precision. stat atk: QueueAttackWithSnap uses the snapshot taken at explosionHitmark with no stat substitution.

NO tickCap, deliberately (tick-cap round, 2026-08-18): gcsim ticks the leaps 12 times to our 11 (its `AddStatus(burstKey, 378)` is 6.3s against the 6s the kit text states), but a flat cap CANNOT be authored here because this summon carries `durationExtensions` - A4 adds +1s per dendro reaction up to three times, and gcsim extends its status to match, so the real tick count grows with the extension. A cap would freeze it at 12 and make the A4 window cosmetic. The one-tick shortfall stays as a known divergence.

icdGate authored 2026-08-17 (ICD-group round b), superseding the note that said our schema could not express it: ICDGroupColleiBurst's table entry (pkg/core/attacks/icd_groups.dm.go) is a 180f reset window in which only the FIRST hit applies. Measured 2/12 applied against standard ICD's 5 — the largest single correction in this migration, and the series L5e §4 recorded as over-applying. Note the explosion at frame 25 shares that same ICD group with the leaps in gcsim; our model still gates a cast's own hits and the summon series separately, which is §4's held counter-sharing question and not this one.

Tick-count divergence, geometry left alone as instructed: gcsim's burstKey status is 378 frames (6.3s) from explosionHitmark, so 12 leaps land (68 + 30×0..11 = 68…398). Our authored duration is 6s from spawn, which fits 11 ticks. The 6s is the sidecar 'Duration' row and the in-game stated value; gcsim's extra 0.3s of status is what buys the 12th.

Trusty Cuilein-Anbar comes to save the day!
Throws the doll named Cuilein-Anbar, causing an explosion that deals AoE Dendro DMG, creating a Cuilein-Anbar Zone. Cuilein-Anbar will bounce around within this zone, dealing AoE Dendro DMG.

passives.name: Floral Sidewinder

_curatorNotes: Reaction list needs KQM verification — generator only captured `burning` but gcsim (dendroEvents) and game text list all dendro reactions: Burning, Quicken, Aggravate, Spread, Bloom, Hyperbloom, Burgeon, Lunar-Bloom. ICD tag in gcsim: ICDTagColleiSprout.

passives.description:
If one of your party members has triggered Burning, Quicken, Aggravate, Spread, Bloom, Hyperbloom, Burgeon, or Lunar-Bloom reactions before the Floral Ring returns, it will grant the character the Sprout effect upon return, which will continuously deal Dendro DMG equivalent to 40% of Collei's ATK to nearby opponents for 3s.
If another Sprout effect is triggered during its initial duration, the initial effect will be removed. DMG dealt by Sprout is considered Elemental Skill DMG.

constellations.name: Through Hill and Copse

_curatorNotes: Inherited `manual` trigger. Likely `onCast` (fires when Floral Ring returns at ~157 frames from E cast start); at C2+ with Ascension ≥ 1, gcsim sets `sproutShouldProc = true` on E cast and adds Sprout unconditionally at skillReturn (no reaction required). Extension fires once per cast via `sproutShouldExtend` flag. Scope: self (Collei). Probable trigger: `{ type: 'onCast', ability: 'skill' }` delayed to ring return.

Sprout's +3s on-dendro-reaction extension would fit `durationExtensions[]` (E5, 2026-05-10) once Sprout is authored as a window — today the Sprout damage effect has a 3s duration but no schema home for runtime extensions (effects don't host durationExtensions, only stance abilities + summons do). Defer until Sprout is authored as a Summon or the primitive grows to cover effect-level windows.

constellations.description:
The Ascension Talent Floral Sidewinder is changed to this:
The Floral Ring will grant the character the Sprout effect from Floral Sidewinder upon return, dealing 40% of Collei's ATK as Dendro DMG to nearby opponents for 3s.
From the moment of using Floral Brush to the moment when this instance of Sprout effect ends, if any of your party members triggers Burning, Quicken, Aggravate, Spread, Bloom, Hyperbloom, Lunar-Bloom, or Burgeon reactions, the Sprout effect will be extended by 3s.
The Sprout effect can only be extended this way once. If another Sprout effect is triggered during its initial duration, the initial effect will be removed. DMG dealt by Sprout is considered Elemental Skill DMG.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Floral Sidewinder."
